info.title: GDR Diary API
info.description: API to manage role-playing characters, their diaries and the diary pages.

tags.name: Diaries
tags.description: Manage the diaries of the characters of the logged-in user

tags.name: Diary pages
tags.description: Manage the pages of the diaries of the logged-in user (maximum 100 pages per diary)

put.description: Replaces the content of a page. The page number cannot be changed directly and the page cannot be moved to another diary. The content must be a document of the diary editor: a doc node with paragraphs (optionally aligned left, center, right or justify), blockquotes, bullet and ordered lists and horizontal rules, where the text and the hard breaks can carry the marks bold, italic, underline and title (level 1 or 2). Any other node, mark or property is rejected. The content must not exceed the configured maximum size. The request must carry the version of the page the client last read: if the page was modified in the meantime nothing is saved and the response is 409. The response carries the new version, to be used for the next update.

200.description: Page updated, with the new version of the page

400.description: Invalid request body (for example empty content or missing version), content that is not a valid diary document, content too large, or page identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Page not found, or its character is owned by another user

409.description: The page was modified in the meantime (another tab or device, or a deletion that renumbered it): nothing is saved and the page must be read again

delete.description: Deletes a page of a diary of a character owned by the logged-in user. The pages that follow are renumbered, so the numbers stay consecutive. The identifiers of the pages do not change.

400.description: Page identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Page not found, its character is owned by another user, or the page was deleted at the same time

409.description: A page of the diary was modified at the same time by another request: nothing is deleted, try again

put.summary: Set the profile image of the logged-in user
put.description: Uploads an image (png, jpeg or webp) as profile image of the logged-in user. The real content of the file is checked, not only the declared type: the file type must be an allowed image, the declared content type must be present and, like the extension, must match the content and the size must not exceed the configured limit. The previous profile image, if any, is replaced and its file is deleted. Returns a temporary URL of the new image, valid for a few minutes.

file.description: The image to use as profile image (png, jpeg or webp)

200.description: Profile image set, with its temporary URL as payload

400.description: Missing file part, malformed multipart request, empty file, unsupported file type, missing or mismatching content type, extension not matching the content, or file too large

404.description: The user has not been created yet (call POST /me first)

409.description: The user was modified at the same time by another request: the profile image is not changed, try again

413.description: File larger than the maximum request size

delete.summary: Remove the profile image of the logged-in user
delete.description: Removes the profile image of the logged-in user and deletes its file.

404.description: The user has not been created yet (call POST /me first)

409.description: The user was modified at the same time by another request: the profile image is not removed, try again

get.description: Returns the email, the premium flag and the settings of the logged-in user, identified by the access token.

404.description: The user has not been created yet (call POST /me first)

post.description: To be called once after every login. Creates the user in the backend the first time, otherwise keeps the email aligned with the access token, and returns the identifier of the user. It is idempotent: calling it again returns the same identifier. Call it again after the email has been changed on the authentication server and the access token has been refreshed: the stored email is aligned with the one in the token.

200.description: The identifier of the logged-in user

400.description: The token has no email address

409.description: The user was modified at the same time by another request, try again

delete.summary: Delete all the data of the logged-in user
delete.description: Permanently deletes everything the logged-in user has in the backend: all the characters with their diaries and pages, the profile image, the images of characters and diaries (files included) and the user itself. It cannot be undone. Everything is deleted in a single transaction: if something fails nothing is deleted. The account on the authentication server is not touched: the client deletes it after this call. It requires a recent login with the password (the auth_time claim of the token, five minutes by default): otherwise it answers 401 and deletes nothing. It is idempotent: if the user has no data any more it still answers 200.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid token, or the last login with the password is older than app.user.delete-max-auth-age (the answer carries WWW-Authenticate with error insufficient_user_authentication and the client must ask for the password again)

409.description: The account changed while it was being deleted (for example a character was created at the same time): nothing is deleted, try again

get.summary: List the pages of a diary
get.description: Returns two pages at a time of a diary of a character owned by the logged-in user, with their content, sorted by page number. Use page=1 for pages 1 and 2, page=2 for pages 3 and 4, and so on. The last spread can contain a single page. A page beyond the end returns an empty list.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Number of the spread to read (1-based), two pages at a time

200.description: Page of diary pages (empty list if none)

400.description: Invalid page parameter (below 1 or not a number), or diary identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Diary not found, or its character is owned by another user

post.description: Adds a page at the end of a diary of a character owned by the logged-in user. The page number is assigned by the server (the next one after the last page) and a diary can have at most 100 pages. The content must be a document of the diary editor: a doc node with paragraphs (optionally aligned left, center, right or justify), blockquotes, bullet and ordered lists and horizontal rules, where the text and the hard breaks can carry the marks bold, italic, underline and title (level 1 or 2). Any other node, mark or property is rejected. The content must not exceed the configured maximum size.

parameters.name: diaryId
parameters.description: Identifier of the diary the page belongs to

400.description: Invalid request body (for example empty content), content that is not a valid diary document, diary full (100 pages), page added at the same time by another request, content too large, or diary identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Diary not found, its character is owned by another user, or the diary was deleted while the page was being created

patch.summary: Update the settings of the logged-in user
patch.description: Merges the settings sent into the stored ones: a key replaces the stored value, a key with a null value is removed, keys that are not sent are left untouched. Nothing but the settings is changed. Returns the settings after the update (an empty object if none are stored).

200.description: Settings updated, with the settings of the logged-in user after the update as payload

400.description: Body missing or malformed, settings missing or empty, settings with characters that cannot be stored, or settings too large

404.description: The user has not been created yet (call POST /me first)

409.description: The settings were modified at the same time by another request: nothing is saved, read them again and retry
